body:
My intention for taking this drug was to replace under par street stimulants with one I can gauge purity better. I bought some from a very reputable source. The aim of this report is to document the effects during and after.
10pm - first 30mg line snorted, It does hurt, quite a lot. As much as or even more then EPH. But that being said, it did go away within 20 seconds.
10:10 Definitely stimulates the mind, in a clearheaded sort of way. Positive feelings and it is very clear. It's not a dirty drug but it is very moreish. Little euphoria at this dosage. When the height subsides, which is usually after 40mins or so for my first dose, there is an urge to redose but not in the same way where Mephedrone always forces me to keep going in order to maintain that high. If I were not to redose, I wouldn't have any negative feelings, it just wouldn't be as intense.
10:30 - Makes me more chatty and social in a non wired sort of way. Its worth mentioning the intensity of this drug at this point. Its not overwhelming like MDMA and not as powerful as cocaine. I could go out and no one would recognize I was on something if I stuck to 25mg-35mg doses. Does give me dry mouth a bit and so far no pupil dilation so keep drinking fluids throughout. No increased heartbeat. It basically gives me a bit of energy and mental focus. Would be useful as a study aid, but recreationally it works really well.
10:45 - urge to redose is there. another 30mg sorted. Pain doesn't get better.
11:30 - 30mg sorted. Each dose gives the same effects. The way this drug goes is that the interval between intakes will get shorter. In my experience it will follow this trend:
00:00 1st dose
01:00 2nd
01:45 3rd
02:15 4th
02:45 5th
03:10 6th
03:25 7th
And then every 15mins I'll find myself wanting to redose. Each dose feels just as good.
Towards my 3-4th dose, I lower, instead of highering. It's just a case of topping up the high bit of the interaction. If I was not to redose, I would still very much enjoy the smoothness I get. I find the pain bad if I binge on this but it's worth it for the brilliant high I receive.
Overall I consumed about 300mg in one session over 6 hours (9pm-3am).
Overall I consumed about 300mg in one session over 6 hours (9pm-3am).
After leaving it at 3am I was able to sleep by 5am.
Now for the after effects, if I was to be truthful, there is none. The comedown doesn't exist. It's a very very smooth transition from high to baseline with no anxiety. The next day I don't have that groggy feeling or regret. Residual stimulation on this is long-lasting. Even after the session, there are no negative thoughts or major body malfunctions.
However, I will have a nose that might be sore and increased phlegm production, There is likely to be blood but only little in my experience. I was drinking lightly (4-5 drinks) which add to the drug's likiness because it mixes well. I have bombed 30mg x2 on heavy drinking and the next day is okay.
In my conclusion, it's the best stim out there
